name: Sora to Kimiiro
source:
Misaki, a boy in the astronomy club, always made a point of keeping his distance, trying not to get too involved with other people.
To him, nothing was "permanent." Believing that everything—his surroundings, relationships, even his own family—was just a temporary connection, he avoided getting too involved with others. Over time, he found himself unable to truly face their feelings.

Then, in the spring of his second year of high school, Misaki meets Himekawa, a transfer student who is blind.
Misaki tries to keep his distance from her, just as he always does. But then, believe it or not, she confesses that she can understand people's emotions just from the tone of their voice!
At first, true to form, Misaki doesn't try to get deeply involved. However, as he unexpectedly starts interacting more with the transfer student in the seat next to him, his everyday life begins to change, bit by bit...
And beyond these changes, what will he eventually come to see...?

"In a world where everything keeps changing, is there anything that remains the same?"

[From [url=https://booth.pm/en/items/6400343]Booth[/url]]
translation:
天文学部的男孩美咲总是刻意保持距离，尽量不与其他人有过多的接触。
对他来说，没有什么是“永恒的”。他相信一切——他的周围环境、人际关系，甚至他自己的家庭——都只是暂时的联系，他避免与他人有太多的牵连。随着时间的推移，他发现自己无法真正面对他们的感受。

然后，在高中二年级的春天，美咲遇到了失明的转学生姬川。
美咲一如既往地试图与她保持距离。但不管你信不信，她承认她可以从人们的语气中了解他们的情绪！
一开始，美咲一如往常，并没有试图深入参与其中。然而，当他意外地开始与邻座的转校生有了更多的互动时，他的日常生活开始一点一点地改变……
除了这些变化之外，他最终会看到什么……？

“在这个一切都在变化的世界里，还有什么是不变的吗？”

[来自[url=https://booth.pm/en/items/6400343]展位[/url]]
